name: app
note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-layr); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://layr.toyz.kr. The app keeps its sample notes in localStorage; the reel's notes, bundles and layers are the app's own result after 모두 수락 on the first run (dumped as state_*.txt). The layer stack and the brand mark are drawn from the app's own SVG code (LayerStack.tsx, Brand.tsx). After capture, the three bundle rows are cut to their heads (head_0..2, CSS [0, 0, 328, 205]) and every PNG is stored as WebP.
